SOUTHERN PROVINCE PROVINCIAL COUNCIL

The Orders and Regulations imposed under the Southern Province Road Passenger Transport Authority Statue No. 2 of 1996 and the Southern Province Road Passenger Transport Authority (Amendment) Statue No. 01 of 2009 of the Southern Provincial Council

SINCE the powers vested in with the Chief Minister of the Southern Provincial Council and the Minister in charge of the subject Law and Order, Finance and Planning, Local Government, Transport, Health and Indigenous Medicine, Tourism and Engineering Services in terms of the Section 41 of the Southern Province Road Passenger Transport Authority Statute No. 02 of 1996 and in terms of the Southern Province Road Passenger Transport Authority (Amendment) statute No. 01 of 2009 have been vested in me, William Wijesinghe Gamage, the Governor of the Southern Province by Section 154 (c) of the Constitution of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka as the said Provincial Council has been dissolved, the Orders imposed by virtue of the said powers are hereby publicized and these orders shall be come in to operation with eﬀ ect from the date of publishing in the Gazette.
Dඋ. Wංඅඅංൺආ Wංඃൾඌංඇ඀ඁൾ Gൺආൺ඀ൾ, Governor to the Southern Province. At the Governor's Oﬃ ce of the Southern Province,On 30th day in the month of April 2024.
